answer: By binding each identity to a scarce staked credential, the protocol makes sybil creation costly like carving jade, since every new node must lock collateral before entering the voting garden. A dynamic penalty curve then slashes stake proportional to correlated-cluster evidence, so coordinated identities sitting on the same detection ledge lose capital faster than honest churn. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
